description: Mislukte requests per applicatie voor functioneel beheer, met de eerste foutmelding en een link naar de volledige trace.

options.content: Kies bovenaan de applicaties die je beheert. Een request hoort bij de applicatie waar hij binnenkwam, ook als de error verderop in de keten ontstond. Klik op een **correlationId** voor de volledige trace van die request.

panels.description: Requests die binnenkwamen via de gekozen applicaties.
panels.title: Requests

targets.expr: count(bottomk by (correlationId) (1, min by (correlationId, applicationName) (min_over_time({job="mule"} | json applicationName, correlationId | correlationId!="" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts [$__range]))) and on (applicationName) label_replace(sum by (mule_app) (count_over_time({job="mule", mule_app=~"$applicationName"} [$__range])), "applicationName", "$1", "mule_app", "(.*)"))

panels.description: Requests via de gekozen applicaties met minstens één error in de keten.
panels.title: Requests met errors

targets.expr: count(sum by (correlationId, applicationName) (sum by (correlationId) (count_over_time({job="mule"} |= "ERROR" | json priority, correlationId | priority="ERROR" | correlationId!="" |~ `(?i)${search:regex}` [$__range])) + on (correlationId) group_left (applicationName) (0 * bottomk by (correlationId) (1, min by (correlationId, applicationName) (min_over_time({job="mule"} | json applicationName, correlationId | correlationId!="" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts [$__range]))))) and on (applicationName) label_replace(sum by (mule_app) (count_over_time({job="mule", mule_app=~"$applicationName"} [$__range])), "applicationName", "$1", "mule_app", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Requests met errors per applicatie
panels.description: Aantal requests met errors per uur, per applicatie waar ze binnenkwamen.

targets.expr: count by (applicationName) (sum by (correlationId, applicationName) (sum by (correlationId) (count_over_time({job="mule"} |= "ERROR" | json priority, correlationId | priority="ERROR" | correlationId!="" |~ `(?i)${search:regex}` [$__auto])) + on (correlationId) group_left (applicationName) (0 * bottomk by (correlationId) (1, min by (correlationId, applicationName) (min_over_time({job="mule"} | json applicationName, correlationId | correlationId!="" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts [$__auto]))))) and on (applicationName) label_replace(sum by (mule_app) (count_over_time({job="mule", mule_app=~"$applicationName"} [$__auto])), "applicationName", "$1", "mule_app", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Mislukte requests
panels.description: Eén regel per mislukte request. De eerste foutmelding is de eerste omschrijving die een applicatie in de keten logde, meestal de oorzaak. Zoeken filtert op de error-regels.

targets.expr: sum by (correlationId, applicationName) (sum by (correlationId) (count_over_time({job="mule"} |= "ERROR" | json priority, correlationId | priority="ERROR" | correlationId!="" |~ `(?i)${search:regex}` [$__range])) + on (correlationId) group_left (applicationName) (0 * bottomk by (correlationId) (1, min by (correlationId, applicationName) (min_over_time({job="mule"} | json applicationName, correlationId | correlationId!="" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts [$__range]))))) and on (applicationName) label_replace(sum by (mule_app) (count_over_time({job="mule", mule_app=~"$applicationName"} [$__range])), "applicationName", "$1", "mule_app", "(.*)")

max by (correlationId) (max_over_time({job="mule"} |= "ERROR" | json priority, correlationId | priority="ERROR" | correlationId!="" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts [$__range]))

bottomk by (correlationId) (1, min by (correlationId, errorType, description) (min_over_time({job="mule"} |= "ERROR" | json priority, correlationId, errorType="content.errorType", description="content.description" | priority="ERROR" | correlationId!="" | description!="" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts [$__range])))

list.label: Applicatie
list.description: Kies de applicaties die je beheert.
